title: Sher e Khuda Ali
body:
Sher e Khuda Ali
Haye Moula
Fuzto be Rabbil Kaaba
Raab e kaaba ki Qasam aaj Ali kamiyab ho gaya
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab ke labo pe nouha hai ya Murtaza Ali
1) Kaisa sitam ye halat e sajda me hogaya
Zalim ne kar diya hai tera sar shigaafta
Ghar mein khuda ke khoon tera behgaya Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Itna shadeed waaris e Ka'aba ka zaqm tha
Talwar mein tha zehar tadapte the Murtaza
Haye ye tujh pa kaisa sitam hogaya Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Sar maghz tak tha zaqmi wasi e Rasool ka
Fusto be rabb e Ka'aba Ali ki zuba'n pe tha
Hir simt goonjhti hai sada haaye ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Sar thaam kar musalle pa baithe hain Murtaza
Rumaal sar pe kasstey hain baba ke Mujtaba
Har simt ghul hai roney ka har lab pa ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Baitus Sharaf ko le ke chale baap ko pisar
Bewa yateem koofe ke sab peethte hain sar
Lab par hai bain hum hue be aasra Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
6) kulsoom bain karti hai Zainab tadapti hain
Ummul Baneen khaak udaati hai roti hai
Ghar me tumhare gham se hai mehshar bapa Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Koofe ke bekaso'n ka sahara nahi raha
Bacho ke sar pe baap ka saya nahi raha
Baitus Sharaf hai bangaya Matam kada ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Ab ye dua hai dil me tadap hai yahi shadeed
Pohnche Najaf mein aur padhe nouha tera Rasheed
Shayer ki tere tum se hai ye iltejaa Ali
<<MINI>>
Masjid me Qatl Hogaye Sher E khuda Ali
